title: 第3章 月下独赏第4章 抢夫人的boss
content_zh:
第3章 月下独赏
刘烨心里那个美啊！没想到重回三年前，竟然可以得到自己梦寐以求的隐藏职业，眼看着四周浩浩荡荡的抢怪大军，刘烨咧嘴一笑，
刘烨不禁一愣，记得自己当初在玩游戏的时候没有听说过这个ID啊？
再往下看，除了自己的本尊ID剑红尘认识，其他的ID竟然没有一个是熟悉的，这让刘烨更加的疑惑了。
“怎么回事？”刘烨心中疑惑重重，有太多的疑惑想要弄清楚，可是自己根本不知道这件事情从何说起。
游戏世界的天劫为什么无缘无故将自己送回三年前，而且还将自己附身在另一个人身上？为什么自己的体能扫描结果能够触发这样强大的隐藏职业？
这个世界怎么了？难道允许两个同样的灵魂一起存在吗？
“唉~！”
幽幽的叹息一声，刘烨不再多想，快步朝新手村长走去，根据他的经验，抢怪升级绝对不是什么明智的选择。
“亲爱的冒险者，欢迎来到封神大陆，我是最最和蔼的新手村长狄龙，见到你很高兴！”白发苍苍的村长老头神棍一样的叫嚷着。
“村长老爷爷，是路德大叔让我来找你求救的！”刘烨微微一笑，直接说出任务触发条件，这个任务是10级练级区才能够遇到的NPC任务，现阶段也只有自己知道这个任务的触发条件。
果然，在听到刘烨的话以后，村长老头怪异的看了他一眼，说道：“咦！路德竟然找了你这么一个小家伙来帮我，既然你是路德派来的，那就帮我干掉小树林里的大黑熊吧！”
“叮！”——
系统提示：获得任务【击杀大黑熊】，新手村最近出现一头凶猛的大黑熊，村长很着急，写信向落日城的好友路德求救……任务目标：击杀大黑熊，将会获得丰厚的奖励！
这个击杀BOSS的任务只有自己知道，所以刘烨并不着急，拎着新手木剑向新手村小树林走去。
5级以下的练级区全都是各种职业的玩家，角色名一个比一个搞笑，刘烨操作跟班二号自信满满的走进5级怪物区域，不少玩家都露出怪异的神色！
“这人脑袋被驴踢了，才1级就敢去5级怪物群，不想活了！”
“跟班二号，这名字有意思，应该是某位有钱人的跟班吧？可能是去试探怪物的实力！”
“可怜的孩子啊！”
…………

听着这些人无厘头的议论，刘烨心中暗笑不已，哥可是奉村长之命去击杀8级BOSS大黑熊的！
当然，刘烨还没有自大到用1级裸奔属性去挑战8级BOSS，虽然他对自己的技术很有信心，但是对自己的属性一点也没信心，必须升个一两级再去，不然自己根本破不开大黑熊的防御。
走进无人的练级区，这里是一片幽静的丛林，空气中弥漫着植物的清香，不时可以看到一些5级怪物出没，刘烨很快便锁定了一只5级怪物疯狂小猫，观察术熟练的丢过去，疯狂小猫的属性立刻出现在自己面前：
【疯狂小猫】（普通怪物）
等级：5
血量：500/500
攻击力：35－43
防御力：5
技能：初级撕咬
刘烨心中了然，以自己现在的攻击力完全可以破防，这样就好说，这些低级麻瓜怪物根本不可能攻击到自己，要知道，自己可是三年后的明星级玩家。
至于初级撕咬这个技能，刘烨并没有在意，撕咬技能几乎是所有野兽类怪物通用的技能，越是强大的怪物，撕咬技能的等级越高！
目前自己只有一个简单的技能【重击】，可以造成110%的物理伤害加100%的魔法伤害，冷却时间只有2秒，也是目前自己最强、最有效的攻击方式。
重击技能催动下，木剑上闪烁着星星点点的蓝色剑芒，直接砸在呆头呆脑的疯狂小猫身上！
“－8”
疯狂小猫受到攻击，立刻朝刘烨这边冲过来，就像是一只发飙的野猫。
刘烨咧嘴轻笑，身子微微一斜，躲开了疯狂小猫的撕咬，一道普通攻击砍过去，带走小猫5点生命值，与此同时，重击的冷却时间已经过去，再次重击过去，砰的一声，这次竟然出了暴击：
“暴击－15”
不管怎么说，这都是好兆头，轻盈的晃动身影，疯狂小猫被他耍的团团转，三分钟以后，刘烨终于结果了小猫的性命。
系统提示：杀死疯狂小猫－5级，获得经验158点，……
与此同时，一道金光撒下，跟班二号升到了2级，属性增强不少，满意的将自由属性加给力量，跟班二号的攻击力直线攀升！

越级杀怪的经验就是丰厚，一番熟练的屠杀之下，用5级疯狂小猫练级越来越轻松，很快便将跟班二号的等级提升到了3级，自己的攻击力也提升了许多。
而此时，随着时间的推移，5级练级区已经有很多玩家出没了，为了低调起见，刘烨决定转移阵地，前往6级怪物区出发！
鬼雾林是一片阴森森的地图，生活着6级到9级的亡灵类怪物，是新手村最恐怖的地图，昏暗的树林里不时飘过绿色的鬼火，很少有女孩子会来这样的地图练级。
刘烨没有闲暇关心这些，飞快锁定一只6级怪物幽灵狼，重击直接砍了过去！
“－24”
不错的伤害数字飘起，刘烨对自己的攻击很满意，那边的幽灵狼已经愤怒的冲过来，刘烨撇嘴一笑，木剑连连挥动，很快便将一头幽灵狼干掉，经验涨了一截。
“咣当——！”幽灵狼死后竟然爆出一件装备。
刘烨大喜，没想到自己RP这么好，杀普通怪物都可以爆出装备，随意的捡起来一看，是一件很普通的白色护甲，但总比自己现在裸奔强。
【粗制皮衣】（白色装备）
等级：1
耐久度：20/20
基础属性：物理防御+3
点击穿在自己身上，一件粗糙的皮衣刚好将自己的身材展现出现，刘烨猛然间发现，原来自己这个身体的身材这么好！
装上新装备的跟班二号勇猛无敌，迅速在鬼雾林展开了屠杀，随着一头头幽灵狼倒下，跟班二号成功的提升到了4级，属性再一次得到强化。
忽然，一只摇头晃脑的哥布林朝自己这边走过老，刘烨大喜，这只哥布林怪物的名称是紫色的，也就是说，这只怪物是稀有怪物！
刘烨知道，封神中的怪物分为：普通怪物、精英怪物、稀有怪物、强化怪物，其中的稀有怪物最为珍贵，因为有许多稀有的道具和材料都是由稀有怪物掉落的。
眼前的哥布林就是一只稀有怪物，欣喜的将观察术丢过去，“叮！”——观察成功：
【迷路哥布林】（稀有怪物）
等级：6
攻击力：47－59

防御力：8
技能：中级猛击、初级自愈术
刘烨不由暗叹一声，不愧是稀有怪物，不仅有中级攻击技能，还有初级自愈术，这样杀起来才有挑战性嘛！
重击——“－23”
“MISS”
没想到还出了MISS，看样子这只稀有怪物的敏捷属性不错，只不过面对自己这样的明星级玩家，它也只有躺倒的份。
对于现阶段处于裸奔状态的跟班二号来说，这只稀有怪物并没有什么危险，唯一有些麻烦的就是那1000点的生命值，杀起来比较费事。
五分钟以后，迷路哥布林倒在木剑之下，爆出一大推战利品，跟班二号的等级也随之提升到了5级！
欣喜的冲过去，将战利品一股脑收进背包，现阶段的背包有50格，足够新手使用了。
仔细的检查一遍，这只稀有怪物共爆出一蓝一紫两件装备、一颗声望之心，还有15枚铜币，算是不错的战利品了：
【精致皮靴】（紫色装备）
等级：5
耐久度：78/78
基础属性：速度+6、闪避+5
附加属性：敏捷+2
【鬼雾林护肩】（蓝色装备）
等级：5
耐久度：60/60
基础属性：魔法防御+5
附加属性：智力+1

【声望之心】稀有道具，使用之后随机获得1－10点人物声望，只有稀有怪物可以掉落。
没想到第一次遇到稀有怪物就爆出了稀有道具声望之心，点击使用后，随机获得了7点声望值，声望值在后期的作用很大，越多越好！
迫不及待的将两件装备穿在身上，跟班二号现在已经不算裸奔了，
ID：跟班二号
职业：九转剑仙
等级：5
声望：7
称号：无
生命值：325
魔法值：250
物理攻击：26－35
魔法攻击：11
物防：11
魔防：13
速度：18
攻速：4
命中：9
闪避：14
暴击率：2%
魅力：0

幸运：0
就在刘烨独自欣赏自己属性的时候，一抹美艳的身影走进了远处的鬼雾林，是一名身材火爆的女法师，粗制的法袍也无法遮盖她的火爆与美丽。
刘烨立刻来了兴趣，偷偷地潜伏过去，看到女法师的角色名以后，心中大惊，此人竟是等级榜第一女法师月下独赏，真是个重口味的MM，一个人都敢来这种鬼地方！
刘烨心中感叹不已，如今封神开服已经有一个小时，主流练级玩家早已经突破了5级大关，而那些牛叉的练级狂早已经达到了7级，就比如说眼前这位女法师，以8级的绝对优势占绝等级榜第一位置。
只见月下独赏手握一支精铁法杖，不断的射出火球术和水球术，熟练的猎杀着9级怪物，看上去很是专注！
鬼雾林的光线本就昏暗，在这种朦朦胧胧的视觉效果下，月下独赏火爆的身材似乎在呼唤刘烨心中的野性。
见月下独赏并没有注意四周，刘烨偷偷地靠近了一些，这一靠近，顿时让刘烨冷汗直冒，一张熟悉的冷艳面孔出现在刘烨的视线，月下独赏竟然是叶夫人大姐大！

Chapter 3: Solitary Reward under the Moon
Liu Ye is so beautiful in his heart! Unexpectedly, going back to three years ago, he would be able to get the hidden career he dreamed of. Seeing the mighty monster grabbing army around him, Liu Ye grinned.
Liu Ye couldn't help but be stunned. He remembered that he had never heard of this ID when he was playing the game?
Looking further down, except for his original ID, Jian Hongchen, none of the other IDs were familiar, which made Liu Ye even more confused.
"What's going on?" Liu Ye was filled with doubts. He had too many doubts that he wanted to clarify, but he had no idea where to start with this matter.
Why did the Heavenly Tribulation in the game world send himself back to three years ago for no reason, and also possessed himself in another person? Why can my physical fitness scan result trigger such a powerful hidden profession?
What's wrong with this world? Are two identical souls allowed to exist together?
"Alas~!"
With a faint sigh, Liu Ye stopped thinking and walked quickly towards the novice village chief. According to his experience, grabbing monsters to upgrade is definitely not a wise choice.
"Dear adventurer, welcome to the Fengshen Continent. I am the most amiable and novice village leader, Di Long. I am very happy to meet you!" The white-haired villager shouted like a stick.
"Grandpa Village Elder, Uncle Luther asked me to come to you for help!" Liu Ye smiled slightly and directly stated the triggering conditions of the task. This task is an NPC task that can only be encountered in the level 10 leveling area. At this stage, only he knows the triggering conditions of this task.
Sure enough, after hearing Liu Ye's words, the village elder gave him a strange look and said, "Hey! Luther actually asked a little guy like you to help me. Since you were sent by Luther, then help me kill the big black bear in the woods!"
"Ding!"——
System prompt: Get the mission [Kill the big black bear]. A ferocious big black bear recently appeared in Novice Village. The village chief was very anxious and wrote to his friend Luther in Sunset City for help... Mission goal: Kill the big black bear and you will get generous rewards!
Only he knew the task of killing the BOSS, so Liu Ye was not in a hurry and walked towards the woods of Novice Village with his novice wooden sword.
The leveling area below level 5 is full of players of various professions, and the character names are funnier than the last. Liu Ye controls Follower No. 2 to confidently walk into the level 5 monster area, and many players have weird looks!
"This guy got kicked in the head by a donkey. He's only level 1 and he dares to go to a group of level 5 monsters. He doesn't want to live anymore!"
"Follow No. 2, that's an interesting name. He must be a follower of a rich man, right? Maybe he's going to test the monster's strength!"
"Poor child!"
…………
Listening to these people's nonsensical comments, Liu Ye secretly laughed in his heart. He was ordered by the village chief to kill the level 8 BOSS Big Black Bear!
Of course, Liu Ye is not arrogant enough to challenge the level 8 BOSS with his level 1 streaking attribute. Although he is very confident in his skills, he has no confidence in his attributes at all. He must upgrade one or two levels before going, otherwise he will not be able to break through the defense of the big black bear.
Walking into the unmanned leveling area, it was a quiet jungle. The air was filled with the fragrance of plants. From time to time, some level 5 monsters could be seen coming and going. Liu Ye quickly locked onto a level 5 monster, Crazy Kitten, and threw it over with skillful observation skills. The attributes of the crazy kitten immediately appeared in front of him:
【Crazy Kitten】(Ordinary Monster)
Level: 5
HP: 500/500
Attack power: 35-43
Defense: 5
Skill: Primary Bite
Liu Ye knew in his heart that with his current attack power, he could completely break through the defense. In this way, it was impossible for these low-level Muggle monsters to attack him. You must know that he would be a star player in three years.
As for the primary bite skill, Liu Ye didn't care.The bite skill is a skill common to almost all beast-type monsters. The more powerful the monster, the higher the level of the bite skill!
Currently, I only have a simple skill [Heavy Attack], which can cause 110% physical damage and 100% magic damage. The cooldown time is only 2 seconds. It is currently my strongest and most effective attack method.
Under the stimulation of the heavy attack skill, the wooden sword flashed with blue sword light, and it hit the stupid crazy kitten directly!
"-8"
The crazy kitten was attacked and immediately rushed towards Liu Ye, like a raging wild cat.
Liu Ye grinned lightly, tilted his body slightly, and avoided the bite of the crazy kitten. He slashed with a normal attack and took away 5 points of the kitten's health. At the same time, the cooldown time of the heavy attack had passed, and he hit hard again. With a bang, this time it was a critical hit:
"Crit-15"
No matter what, this was a good sign. With his light and swaying figure, the crazy kitten was spun around by him. Three minutes later, Liu Ye finally killed the kitten.
System prompt: Kill the crazy kitten - level 5, gain 158 experience points,...
At the same time, a golden light fell, and Follower No. 2 was promoted to level 2. His attributes were greatly enhanced. With satisfaction, he added free attributes to his strength. Follower No. 2's attack power soared!
The experience of killing monsters beyond levels is rich. After some skilled slaughter, it became easier and easier to level up with the level 5 Crazy Kitten. He soon raised the level of follower No. 2 to level 3, and his own attack power also increased a lot.
At this time, as time went by, many players appeared in the level 5 leveling area. In order to keep a low profile, Liu Ye decided to move his position and head to the level 6 monster area!
The Ghostly Mist Forest is a gloomy map, inhabited by level 6 to level 9 undead monsters. It is the scariest map in the Novice Village. Green will-o’-wisps float from time to time in the dim woods. Very few girls would come to such a map for leveling.
Liu Ye didn't have time to care about this. He quickly locked onto a level 6 monster ghost wolf and slashed it with a heavy blow!
"-24"
A good damage figure floated up. Liu Ye was very satisfied with his attack. The ghost wolf over there had already rushed over angrily. Liu Ye curled his lips and waved his wooden sword repeatedly. He quickly killed a ghost wolf and his experience increased.
"Bang!" After the ghost wolf died, a piece of equipment exploded.
Liu Ye was overjoyed. He didn't expect that his RP was so good. He could get equipment by killing ordinary monsters. He picked it up casually and saw that it was a very ordinary white armor, but it was better than running naked now.
[Rough leather jacket] (white equipment)
Level: 1
Durability: 20/20
Basic attributes: Physical defense +3
Clicking to put it on himself, a rough leather jacket just showed off his figure. Liu Ye suddenly discovered that his figure was so good!
Follower No. 2, equipped with new equipment, was brave and invincible, and quickly started a massacre in the Ghost Mist Forest. As the ghost wolves fell one after another, Follower No. 2 successfully upgraded to level 4, and his attributes were once again strengthened.
Suddenly, a swaying Goblin walked towards him. Liu Ye was overjoyed. The name of this Goblin monster was purple, which meant that this monster was a rare monster!
Liu Ye knew that the monsters in Fengshen were divided into: ordinary monsters, elite monsters, rare monsters, and enhanced monsters. Among them, the rare monsters were the most precious because many rare props and materials were dropped by rare monsters.
The Goblin in front of him was a rare monster. He happily threw the observation skill over, "Ding!" - the observation was successful:
[Lost Goblin] (rare monster)
Level: 6
Attack power: 47-59
Defense: 8
Skills: Intermediate slamming, primary self-healing technique
Liu Ye couldn't help but secretly sigh. He was indeed a rare monster. Not only did he haveSuper attack skills, as well as basic self-healing skills, so killing is more challenging!
Heavy blow - "-23"
"MISS"
Unexpectedly, MISS was released. It seems that this rare monster has good agility attributes, but it can only lie down when faced with a star player like me.
For Follower No. 2, who is currently running naked, this rare monster is not dangerous. The only thing that is a little troublesome is the 1,000 points of health, which is more troublesome to kill.
Five minutes later, the lost goblin fell under the wooden sword, bursting with a large amount of loot, and the level of follower No. 2 was also raised to level 5!
He rushed over happily and put the loot into his backpack. The current backpack has 50 slots, which is enough for novices.
After careful inspection, this rare monster revealed a total of two pieces of equipment, one blue and one purple, a heart of reputation, and 15 copper coins, which are considered good trophies:
[Exquisite Leather Boots] (Purple Equipment)
Level: 5
Durability: 78/78
Basic attributes: Speed +6, Dodge +5
Additional attributes: Agility +2
[Ghost Forest Shoulders] (blue equipment)
Level: 5
Durability: 60/60
Basic attributes: Magic defense +5
Additional attributes: Intelligence +1
[Heart of Reputation] A rare prop that will randomly gain 1-10 character reputation points after use. Only rare monsters can drop it.
Unexpectedly, the first time I met a rare monster, I exploded the rare item Reputation Heart. After clicking to use it, I randomly gained 7 reputation points. Reputation points play a great role in the later stage. The more the better!
He couldn't wait to put on the two pieces of equipment. Follower No. 2 was no longer running naked.
ID: Follower No. 2
Occupation: Nine-turn Sword Immortal
Level: 5
Reputation: 7
Title: None
HP: 325
Magic value: 250
Physical attack: 26-35
Magic Attack: 11
Physical defense: 11
Magic Defense: 13
Speed: 18
Attack speed: 4
Hits: 9
Dodge: 14
Critical hit rate: 2%
Charm: 0
Lucky: 0
Just when Liu Ye was admiring his attributes alone, a beautiful figure walked into the ghost mist forest in the distance. It was a female mage with a fiery figure. Even the rough robe could not cover up her fiery and beautiful appearance.
Liu Ye immediately became interested and lurked over secretly. After seeing the name of the female mage's character, he was shocked. This person was actually the number one female mage on the level list. She was such a heavy-handed girl that no one dared to come to such a ghost place!
Liu Ye sighed inwardly. It has been an hour since the Fengshen server was launched. Mainstream leveling players have already broken through the level 5 mark, and those awesome leveling enthusiasts have already reached level 7. For example, the female mage in front of him has an absolute advantage of level 8 and takes the first place in the level list.
I saw Duzhang under the moon holding a fine iron staff, constantly shooting fireballs and waterballs, and skillfully hunting level 9 monsters. He looked very focused!
The light in the Ghostly Mist Forest was already dim. Under this hazy visual effect, the hot figure of the moonlit figure seemed to be calling out the wildness in Liu Ye's heart.
Seeing that Yuexia Dushang was not paying attention to his surroundings, Liu Ye sneaked closer. This approach suddenly made Liu Ye break into a cold sweat. A familiar cold face appeared in Liu Ye's sight. Yuexia Dushang turned out to be Mrs. Ye!
